scope: Assess candidate open-source projects against current ModelBroker, CapabilityRegistry, Context Capsule, Gateway and Execution Fabric boundaries
Classify candidates as PILOT, ARCHITECTURE_REFERENCE, DEFER, or REJECT
Define three bounded integration waves and hard acceptance gates
non_goals: Enabling Cua or any computer-use provider on YASSIN
acceptance_criteria: Every candidate has a boundary-preserving disposition
No candidate can grant itself authority or silently select/fallback a model
Command Center .NET compatibility is considered explicitly
No production code or live capability state is modified
